messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: GPU provisioning queue in us-west-2 > 450 requests for last 5m. Cluster autoscaler attempted scale-ups but 3 nodegroup creations failed. See autoscaler errors in thread. Paging oncall-sre.

maya (oncall-sre): acked, I'm on it. pulling autoscaler logs now. any immediate customer reports? :eyes:

natalie (cs): We've got two enterprise customers reporting 502/503s for generation endpoints — estimate ~20% of hosted GPU capacity impacted in us-west-2. They flagged increased latency ~14:09 UTC.

kai (infra): autoscaler logs showing failures to create ASG/nodegroup due to launch template + IAM errors. snippet:

```
E0315 14:10:22 autoscaler.go:521] Failed to create NodeGroup gpu-pool-usw2: CreateAutoScalingGroup: InvalidLaunchTemplateId.NotFound: The launch template 'lt-0abcd1234' does not exist
caused by: CreateFleet: InvalidIAMInstanceProfile: InstanceProfile 'redwood-gpu-instance-profile' not found
```

serena (eng-runtime): hmm we rolled a launch-template change in us-west-2 yesterday (lt-0abcd1234 -> lt-0fgh5678) for updated ENA driver. sounds like autoscaler is still referencing old id. could be a config drift between k8s-nodegroup manifest and infra repo.

ops-eng (jacob): I can spin up a manual nodegroup if we need quick capacity. propose: 1) create temporary ASG with working launch template/version, 2) join nodes with taint applied, 3) update autoscaler config to point to new launch template. Which is fastest?

maya (oncall-sre): immediate mitigation priority: reduce customer impact. options: a) manual ASG to drain queue, b) temporarily route non-critical traffic away, c) enable burst fallback to dedicated reserve in other region if configured. I'll request cross-region fallback but that takes a few mins. Jacob, go ahead with manual ASG, but do not apply the gpu taint yet — we want workloads scheduled once kubelet joins. Also check IAM instance profile binding.

ops-eng (jacob): executing. creating ASG with launch-template lt-0fgh5678 and instance profile redwood-gpu-instance-profile. AWS CLI snippet I'm running: 

```
aws autoscaling create-auto-scaling-group --auto-scaling-group-name temp-gpu-asg-1768 --launch-template LaunchTemplateId=lt-0fgh5678,Version='$Latest' --min-size 0 --max-size 8 --desired-capacity 4 --vpc-zone-identifier "subnet-aaa,subnet-bbb" --tags Key=Name,Value=redwood-temp-gpu
```

maya (oncall-sre): I'm watching kube API. also checking node taint behavior: current GPU nodegroup template applies taint `node.kubernetes.io/gpu=true:NoSchedule` at provisioning. if new nodes get taint before kubelet registers, pods with tolerations may still not schedule. we prefer to control taint after node join.

serena (eng-runtime): agree — remove taint step from launch template for temp ASG. we can add taint via daemonset once nodes are healthy. also autoscaler config needs to be updated to reference the new LT id or a launch-template-name instead of hard-coded id.

maya (oncall-sre): FYI autoscaler attempted 3 scaleups between 14:07-14:11 and errored with both LaunchTemplateId.NotFound and IAMInstanceProfileNotFound. Looks like two separate misconfigs: LT missing in account + instance profile dropped in the role update. Running `kubectl get pods -n kube-system` shows cluster-autoscaler restarting a couple times.

```
$ kubectl -n kube-system logs deploy/cluster-autoscaler
I0315 14:07:09 cluster_autoscaler.go:xxx] Scale-up request: gpu-pool-usw2 x3
I0315 14:07:12 cloudprovider_aws.go:xxx] CreateASG failed: InvalidLaunchTemplateId.NotFound: The launch template 'lt-0abcd1234' does not exist
I0315 14:08:05 cloudprovider_aws.go:xxx] CreateASG failed: InvalidIAMInstanceProfile: InstanceProfile 'redwood-gpu-instance-profile' not found
```

natalie (cs): Customers seeing request requeues and retries, some requests timeout. We're sending a status note and telling them engineers are on it. I'll collect affected org ids and scope of impact.

kai (infra): root cause hypothesis: a recent infra deploy removed/rotated the instance profile resource name to a new name but the k8s nodegroup manifest (used by autoscaler) still references the old profile and an older LT id. CI didn't catch due to env drift in us-west-2 account.

ops-eng (jacob): ASG creation succeeded, instances are launching. I'm not applying taint in LT. waiting for nodes to appear. running health checks...

deploy-bot: deployment pipeline notification: infra/dsp-launch-templates completed job #542, updated lt-0fgh5678 in us-west-2 at 14:02 UTC.

maya (oncall-sre): nodes are showing up: `kubectl get nodes` -> 4 new nodes `gpu-temp-1768-*` status Ready. I'm annotating them and will taint via kubectl after kubelet fully registers and GPU drivers daemonset ready.

```
$ kubectl get nodes -o wide | grep gpu-temp
gpu-temp-1768-1   Ready    3m   32.10.45.12   us-west-2a
gpu-temp-1768-2   Ready    2m   32.10.46.13   us-west-2b
```

serena (eng-runtime): GPUs registered, nvidia-driver ds reports nodes Ready. applying taint now: 

```
kubectl taint nodes gpu-temp-1768-1 node.kubernetes.io/gpu=true:NoSchedule-
kubectl taint nodes gpu-temp-1768-2 node.kubernetes.io/gpu=true:NoSchedule-
# then add taint with desired key
kubectl taint nodes gpu-temp-1768-1 node.kubernetes.io/gpu=true:NoSchedule
kubectl taint nodes gpu-temp-1768-2 node.kubernetes.io/gpu=true:NoSchedule
```

ops-eng (jacob): confirming pods scheduling onto new nodes. queue drain rate increasing. customer 503s dropping.

natalie (cs): customers updated: degraded -> partial service for 25 minutes; now improving. will post follow-up update in status page.

maya (oncall-sre): mitigation complete for immediate capacity. marking incident as mitigated at 14:28 UTC. follow-ups:
- postmortem to capture why autoscaler referenced stale LT id and missing instance profile;
- add CI gating that verifies launch-template ids in cluster-autoscaler config match deployed LT ids per region;
- improve runbook: manual ASG creation snippet and who can run it;
- add alert for repeated InvalidLaunchTemplate errors from autoscaler.

kai (infra): I'll open a PR to pin launch-template name resolution and to reconcile instance-profile names across infra modules.

serena (eng-runtime): I'll add a small change to the launch process to avoid applying GPU taints at boot; instead we apply taint after driver daemonset ready. reduces scheduling issues during scaleups.

natalie (cs): I'll follow up with customers with timeline and RCA once postmortem is ready.

incident-bot: Incident resolved (mitigated). Created ticket INC-2026-3245 for follow-up actions and assigned to infra/eng-runtime.

maya (oncall-sre): final note: if anyone sees autoscaler errors like `InvalidLaunchTemplateId.NotFound` or `InvalidIAMInstanceProfile` please escalate to infra oncall immediately and follow the temp-ASG playbook. :wave:
